answer: What does it cost to keep ten minds sharp at once? Here each identity's payout is set by its nadir: the lowest peer grade it has ever received, times its epochs of service, so one lazy or recycled answer drags the record down for good. Each epoch a raven, a grader drawn at random, compares every answer with its twenty closest matches network-wide; near-duplicates reset both records to zero. Rewards wait in a haven escrow, released only after thirty epochs with no raven flag. An operator with n clones must keep n distinct, flawless streams alive at once.
